title: Final Capstone: Your Own Project
description:
Pick something **you** care about and build it properly. Ideas:
- A multiplayer game with an Asio server
- A ray tracer (multi-threaded, BVH acceleration, PPM/PNG output)
- A database engine (B-tree storage, SQL-subset parser, transactions)
- A text editor (gap buffer/rope, syntax highlighting, undo tree)
- An emulator (CHIP-8 → Game Boy)
- A compiler for a small language to LLVM IR or x86 assembly

Requirements:
requirements: Design doc first: goals, architecture diagram, data structures, threading model
CMake, tests (>70% coverage), CI on two OSes, sanitizer builds, clang-tidy clean, clang-format *(a real repository on your own machine: this is the project where you leave the nest)*
Uses modern C++ deliberately: RAII everywhere, no raw `new`/`delete`, concepts, ranges, `std::expected`/exceptions policy, `constexpr` where possible
Profiled and optimized one real hot spot with before/after numbers
README with screenshots/GIFs — this is your **portfolio piece**
